engineering.detail: The provider-credit-only matrix finished at18:54:33 UTC after approximately seven hours. Terminus-2 passed3/89 and OpenHands passed1/89. All178 unique cells have binary verifier outcomes and complete cleanup, no partial attempts remain, both baseline services are inactive, and no task containers remain. Frozen qualification bindings still match. The audit found171 HTTP429 rate-limit responses among403 requests, affecting87 Terminus-2 and84 OpenHands attempts under the no-retry policy; five other OpenHands attempts recorded NetworkConnectionError without a saved model request. No provider-credit stop was recorded. There were no project monetary caps or reserve, but these are heavily rate-limited operational scores, not a clean capability comparison. Known response-reported cost subtotal for this run only is US$0.07185378;171 missing cost values mean the complete billed total is unknown. Private off-server evidence and historical-results backups have verified checksums. The original178, capped-repeat151 and uncapped178 result sets remain separate. The legacy live tracks below still refer to the ORIGINAL experiment. Custom development and a demonstrated custom win remain unfinished. See stage2/results/baseline-credit-only-20260922/README.md.
